label: 1-2 steps after an early i, before copying starts
explanation: Fires during the original input and on the delimiter, one or two steps after the letter i was input. It is strongest on the step right after an i: when prev_tok is i the rate is 45% vs about 3% overall, and those steps carry 58% of the activation mass. It is weaker two steps after. It is largest early in the sequence (t=2-5), and a run like i i gives the top activations (around 0.9-1.0 of max on the token after ii). It mostly does not fire when the i comes late (t>6), never fires at t=0, and is almost silent in the copy phase (2% of mass). The predicate scores dev precision 0.83, recall 0.67, F1 0.74, mass recall 0.85. The misses are many weak activations spread over sequences with no i.
